 (x)clusive!: NCT 127 brings their LEGACY to Singapore with their 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY – THE REDLINE’
 Oct 25, 2026 Germx 
 (x)clusive stories   Events   Kpop   Reviews   Singapore 
 If you thought this tour wouldn’t be worth attending because NCT 127 weren’t performing as a full group this time, well, it would actually be your loss. NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY: SINGAPORE – THE REDLINE’ took place at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on 18 October 2026, and the five-member lineup absolutely killed it.
 It had been a long four years since NCT 127 last performed in Singapore with their second tour, ‘NEO CITY – THE LINK’ , in 2022. This time, the lineup featured Taeyong, Johnny, Yuta, Jaehyun, and Haechan, with Doyoung and Jungwoo absent as they were serving their mandatory military service. Yuta, meanwhile, had not performed in Singapore since 2018, making this his first appearance here in eight years. That was way too long, if you asked us! Even four years was too long.
 The energy was through the roof with this particular mix of members, and the five proved to be a cohesive unit, giving each member the opportunity to showcase their individual strengths. THE REDLINE kicked off with ‘Legacy’, a powerful track from their latest release, BLINGY – The 7th Album, which reflects on NCT 127’s journey from their beginnings to where they are today.
 The first 40 minutes were relentless, packed with consecutive high-energy tracks, including all-time hits like ‘Simon Says’ and ‘2 Baddies’, that left almost no room to catch a breath. Yet, the members never faltered for a moment. Taeyong, in particular, brought his signature intensity to the stage, commanding attention with his rap delivery and the kind of stage presence that made it difficult to look away.
 The crowd also loved ‘Lemonade’ and ‘Bring the Noize’, but one thing that really stood out during this opening sequence was the new line distribution for ‘Cherry Bomb’. With the rearranged parts, Haechan, the youngest member of NCT 127, took on the iconic opening rap and proved that he could command the stage just as effortlessly. Or should we say, he was the biggest hit on the stage ? On the other hand, Yuta, who was finally back to meet his Singapore fans, also impressed as he took on many of Doyoung’s signature high notes.
 During their MENT segments, the members spoke about how much they had missed their Singapore fans, or NCTzens. They also waxed lyrical about missing the pepper crab and chilli crab that they could only get to enjoy here. It was funny, and somewhat baffling, as they went on about crabs for a good few minutes until Johnny had to intervene and remind them to get back to the concert. Taeyong also seemed particularly fond of saying “slay”, but we couldn’t agree more: NCT 127 were indeed super slay!
 Other new tracks from BLINGY that blew us away with their incredible choreography and even more impressive vocals were ‘IKR’ and ‘Piñata’. A particular highlight of ‘IKR’ was Haechan’s exceptionally crisp and quick dance moves right after the first chorus, which drew loud cheers from all around the stadium. Jaehyun also brought his signature smooth vocals to the mix, adding another layer to the group’s performances and complementing the intensity of their choreography.
The energy continued with ‘Fire Truck’, a throwback to one of NCT 127’s earlier releases that reminded us of the distinctive sound that helped define the group’s identity. ‘Fact Check’ kept the momentum going with its bold beats, while ‘Kick It’ stood out with its striking visuals of a dragon soaring across the backdrop, a fitting symbolism of the stage presence that has become synonymous with NCT 127.
 But, of course, NCT 127 are about more than just powerful choreography and pure aura. They are the whole package, bringing together dancing, rapping, and singing in a way that few can match. With songs like ‘Not Alone’ and ‘Day After Day’, they also reminded us of the bond they share with their fans and why they will always be NCT 127 to NCTzens. Fans missing Doyoung and Jungwoo also got a little treat, as both appeared in the ‘I mean, it’s about time’ VCR. A recording of them singing their respective parts also played during the encore performance of ‘Promise You’.
 The members also made sure to connect with fans throughout the concert, including throwing paper planes into the crowd during ‘Paper Plane’. Johnny and Taeyong notably took plenty of selfies and videos with fans, while Yuta’s fans were especially delighted to see him up close after such a long wait.
 But the concert wasn’t over just yet. Singapore NCTzens were exceptionally passionate, and their loud chants for a second encore did not go unnoticed. NCT 127 returned to the stage for another round, performing ‘BLINGY’ once more and giving everyone a fittingly high-energy end to the night.
 The members said they hoped to return to Singapore soon, and we certainly hope the next visit won’t take quite as long! The fans had shown their dedication and passion throughout the night, and if anything, the reception was proof of just how much NCT 127 are still loved here.
 One thing’s for sure: as much as we look forward to seeing the full group back on tour, this five-member lineup was every bit as fire.
 Thank you to UnUsUaL Entertainment for the media invite!
 Text by: Pearl | Photos from: UnUsUaL Entertainment
